summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking sit right on top of your judgment about what's possible. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The challenge is that inspiration can start to masquerade as progress. A conversation can feel so productive, so exciting, so full of possibility that neither of you notices nothing has actually moved forward yet. The vision expands, but the next step remains undefined.
advice: Take the encouragement. Take the perspective. Then bring it down to earth.
summaryShort: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking sit right on top of your judgment about what's possible.
